description: Automate refresh, hypercore, retention, and custom tasks with scheduled jobs

import * as C from "@constants";

Automation splits into built-in policies (refresh, columnstore, retention, reordering) and custom {C.JOB}s you schedule yourself. Out of the box, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} ships with policies such as:

- [{C.CAGG_CAP} policies](/build/continuous-aggregates/refresh-policies) to automatically refresh {C.CAGG}s
- [{C.COLUMNSTORE_CAP} policies](/reference/timescaledb/hypercore/add_columnstore_policy) to convert historical data to the {C.COLUMNSTORE}
- [Retention policies](/build/data-management/data-retention/create-a-retention-policy) to drop historical data
- [Reordering policies](/reference/timescaledb/hypertables/add_reorder_policy) to reorder data within {C.CHUNK}s

If these don't cover your use case, you can create and schedule custom-defined {C.JOB}s to run within
your database. They help you automate periodic tasks that aren't covered by the native policies.

In this section, you see how to:

- [Create and manage custom {C.JOB}s](/build/data-management/create-and-manage-jobs)
- [Create a custom retention {C.JOB}](/build/data-management/example-generic-retention)
- [Create a custom {C.JOB} for automatic tablespace management](/build/data-management/example-tiered-storage)
- [Create a custom {C.JOB} to downsample and compress {C.CHUNK}s](/build/data-management/example-downsample-and-compress)
